# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** Widowed  <sub>[v2 c26 P3](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0003)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mrs. Rachel  <sub>[v2 c26 P4](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0004)</sub>; Mrs. Rachel Lynde  <sub>[v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is a fat woman who waddles when she moves. She is an older woman with hands hardened by long years of work.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P31](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0031), [v2 c26 P1](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0001), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015)_

## Personality

Mrs. Lynde prides herself on speaking her mind directly without fear or favor. She is known throughout the community as a busybody who frequently offers unasked-for opinions. Despite her sharp tongue, she possesses a very kind heart, consistently helps the poor, and shows great patience and devotion in caring for the sick.

_Sources: [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c9 P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 c9 P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

## Traits

- Outspoken and opinionated
- Kind-hearted and charitable to the poor  <sub>[v2 c9 P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010)</sub>
- Busybody  <sub>[v2 c9 P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003)</sub>
- Patient and unwearied nurse  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)</sub>

## Abilities

- Knitting quilts  <sub>[v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
- Nursing and caregiving  <sub>[v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)</sub>
- Child-rearing experience  <sub>[v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)</sub>

## Goals

- To remain living in Avonlea among her long-standing friends and community  <sub>[v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P27](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0027)</sub>
- To raise funds for church and community needs  <sub>[v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000)</sub>

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde lived for decades in Lynde's Hollow in Avonlea with her husband Thomas. When Matthew Cuthbert brought orphan Anne Shirley to Green Gables, Rachel visited and criticized Anne's freckles and red hair, provoking an explosive outburst from the child. Though offended, she eventually accepted Anne's apology. Over the years, she maintained an active role in Avonlea's local affairs, soliciting funds for church carpets and keeping close watch on neighborhood activities. When her husband Thomas fell gravely ill, she nursed him tenderly until his peaceful death. Facing financial difficulties due to a mortgaged farm and medical bills, she expected to leave Avonlea until Marilla Cuthbert invited her to move into Green Gables. Rachel accepted the offer, relocating to the north gable and spare room of Green Gables while helping Marilla care for the young Keith twins.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 c26 P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 c26 P3](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0003), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P21](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0021), [v2 c26 P23](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0023), [v2 c26 P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026)_

## Background by volume

- Raised ten children and buried two  <sub>[v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)</sub>
- Lived as a neighbor to Marilla Cuthbert for forty-five years  <sub>[v2 c26 P17](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0017)</sub>
- Mortgaged her farm eight years prior to her husband's death to help her youngest boy go west  <sub>[v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015)</sub>

## Quotes

> Did anybody ever see such a temper!  <sub>[v1 c9 P21](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0021)</sub>

> Well, I don’t envy you your job bringing that up, Marilla.  <sub>[v1 c9 P24](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0024)</sub>

> I certainly never thought of living as far off the road as Green Gables. But really, Green Gables doesn’t seem as out of the world as it used to do . . . Anne has lots of company and the twins make it real lively. And anyhow, I’d rather live at the bottom of a well than leave Avonlea.  <sub>[v2 c26 P27](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0027)</sub>

> I won’t meddle with you nor you with me, and as for the twins, I’ll be glad to do all I can for them; but I won’t undertake to answer Davy’s questions, that’s what.
